<a id="symbol-TokenId"></a>
## `TokenId` · immutable record · [source](text.aug#L6)

Case-sensitive application identifier: 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, period, underscore or tilde.
This is the RFC 3986 unreserved character set. The original spelling is retained.

It takes `text` as a string, kept read-only. Construction can fail with `ConversionError`.

<a id="symbol-TokenId.initialize"></a>
### `TokenId.initialize` · [source](text.aug#L6)

It checks that `text` is a URL-safe ASCII token with `1` to `128` characters. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. [source](text.aug#L8-L9)

<a id="symbol-parseTokenId"></a>
## `parseTokenId` · [source](text.aug#L12)

Validate an identifier without normalizing it. Raises ConversionError for the same inputs as TokenId. It takes `text` as a string. It returns a [`TokenId`](text.aug.md#symbol-TokenId) with `text`. [source](text.aug#L13)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
parseTokenId(string text) returns TokenId unless ConversionError
```

It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

</details>

<a id="symbol-formatTokenId"></a>
## `formatTokenId` · [source](text.aug#L16)

Return the original identifier text. It takes `value` as [`TokenId`](text.aug.md#symbol-TokenId). It returns `value.text`. [source](text.aug#L17)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
formatTokenId(TokenId value) returns string
```

It takes `value` as [`TokenId`](text.aug.md#symbol-TokenId).

</details>

<a id="symbol-BoundedText"></a>
## `BoundedText` · immutable record · [source](text.aug#L24)

Valid UTF-8 text with inclusive byte bounds. Preserve combining sequences and embedded NUL. It takes `text` as a string, kept read-only, `minBytes` as an integer, kept read-only (Minimum UTF-8 storage bytes, including zero), and `maxBytes` as an integer, kept read-only (Maximum storage bytes; require minBytes <= maxBytes <= 1048576). Construction can fail with `ConversionError`.

<a id="symbol-BoundedText.initialize"></a>
### `BoundedText.initialize` · [source](text.aug#L24)

It checks that `minBytes` is at least `0` and `minBytes` is at most `maxBytes` and `maxBytes` is at most `1048576` and `text.byteLength` is at least `minBytes` and `text.byteLength` is at most `maxBytes`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It calls `text.codePointLength`. [source](text.aug#L26-L30)

<a id="symbol-parseBoundedText"></a>
## `parseBoundedText` · [source](text.aug#L35)

Validate original UTF-8 text and inclusive byte bounds without normalization. It takes `text` as a string and `minBytes` and `maxBytes` as integers. It returns a [`BoundedText`](text.aug.md#symbol-BoundedText) with `text`, `minBytes`, and `maxBytes`. [source](text.aug#L36)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
parseBoundedText(string text, int minBytes, int maxBytes) returns BoundedText unless ConversionError
```

It takes `text` as a string and `minBytes` and `maxBytes` as integers. Failures can raise `ConversionError` (Invalid bounds, length or UTF-8).

</details>

<a id="symbol-formatBoundedText"></a>
## `formatBoundedText` · [source](text.aug#L39)

Return the original text, including embedded NUL and combining sequences. It takes `value` as [`BoundedText`](text.aug.md#symbol-BoundedText). It returns `value.text`. [source](text.aug#L40)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
formatBoundedText(BoundedText value) returns string
```

It takes `value` as [`BoundedText`](text.aug.md#symbol-BoundedText).

</details>
